methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: with this paper focusing strongly on action management

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Describes a web-based decision-support/software platform (VSNavigator) and an ISO 50001 action-management framework for school buildings; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). Falls under the tool/software-and-framework exclusion.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The VSNavigator is a web platform for public school stakeholders that provides the tools necessary to develop and implement an Energy Management Program

stage1.notes: Mentions an ISO 50001 base line and an Energy Flow Assessor (Sankey), but neither is characterised as an EnPI/EnB model; context is school buildings.
